        }

        /* ===========================================
           MANDATORY VIEWPORT BASE STYLES
           =========================================== */
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

        html, body {
            height: 100%;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        html {
            scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        .slide {
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
            scroll-snap-align: start;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
        }

        .slide-content {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            max-height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            padding: var(--slide-padding);
        }

        .card, .container, .content-box {
            max-width: min(90vw, 1000px);
            max-height: min(80vh, 700px);
        }

        .feature-list, .bullet-list {
            gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1vh, 1rem);
        }

        .feature-list li, .bullet-list li {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 250px), 1fr));
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
        }

        img, .image-container {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: min(50vh, 400px);
            object-fit: contain;
        }

        @media (max-height: 700px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.75rem, 3vw, 2rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.4rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 4.5vw, 2.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 600px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.5rem, 2.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --content-gap: clamp(0.3rem, 1vw, 0.75rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1.1rem, 4vw, 2rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 0.95rem);
            }
            .nav-dots, .keyboard-hint, .decorative {
                display: none;
            }
        }

        @media (max-height: 500px) {
            :root {
                --slide-padding: clamp(0.4rem, 2vw, 1rem);
                --title-size: clamp(1rem, 3.5vw, 1.5rem);
                --h2-size: clamp(0.9rem, 2.5vw, 1.25rem);
                --body-size: clamp(0.65rem, 1vw, 0.85rem);
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            :root {
                --title-size: clamp(1.25rem, 7vw, 2.5rem);
            }
            .grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            *, *::before, *::after {
                animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
                transition-duration: 0.2s !important;
            }
            html {
                scroll-behavior: auto;
            }
        }

        /* ===========================================
           PRESENTATION STYLES
           =========================================== */
        body {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .slide {
            background: var(--bg-secondary);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        /* Grid background pattern */
        .grid-bg::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background-image:
                linear-gradient(var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px),
                linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grid-line) 1px, transparent 1px);
            background-size: clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px) clamp(30px, 4vw, 60px);
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .slide-content {
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* Slide number */
        .slide-num {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            left: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(0.7rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            z-index: 2;
        }

        h1, h2, h3 {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            line-height: 1.1;
            letter-spacing: -0.02em;
        }

        h1 { font-size: var(--title-size); }
        h2 { font-size: var(--h2-size); }
        h3 { font-size: var(--h3-size); }

        p, li {
            font-family: var(--font-body);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            line-height: 1.6;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .accent-bar {
            width: clamp(40px, 5vw, 80px);
            height: 4px;
            background: var(--accent);
            margin-bottom: var(--content-gap);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           ANIMATIONS
           =========================================== */
        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(25px);
            transition: opacity var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform var(--duration-normal) var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateY(0);
        }

        .reveal:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0.05s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.15s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.25s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.35s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.45s; }
        .reveal:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.55s; }

        .reveal-left {
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateX(-40px);
            transition: opacity 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo),
                        transform 0.7s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .slide.visible .reveal-left {
            opacity: 1;
            transform: translateX(0);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           TITLE SLIDE
           =========================================== */
        .title-slide {
            background: var(--bg-dark);
            color: #fff;
        }

        .title-slide .slide-content {
            justify-content: flex-end;
            padding-bottom: clamp(3rem, 8vh, 6rem);
        }

        .title-slide h1 {
            color: #fff;
            max-width: 85%;
        }

        .title-slide .subtitle {
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
            font-size: var(--subtitle-size);
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .title-slide .meta {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            margin-top: clamp(1.5rem, 3vh, 3rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .title-slide .big-number {
            position: absolute;
            top: clamp(2rem, 6vh, 5rem);
            right: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(4rem, 15vw, 14rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.15;
            line-height: 1;
            z-index: 0;
        }

        .title-slide .accent-line {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 5px;
            background: var(--accent);
        }

        /* ===========================================
           CONTENT SLIDES
           =========================================== */
        .columns-2 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            align-items: start;
        }

        .columns-3 {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            align-items: start;
        }

        @media (max-width: 768px) {
            .columns-2, .columns-3 {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        .challenge-card {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-top: 3px solid var(--accent);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        .challenge-card h3 {
            font-size: var(--h3-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.8vh, 0.6rem);
        }

        .challenge-card p {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .challenge-card .number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            opacity: 0.3;
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        /* Framework diagram */
        .framework-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
        }

        .framework-item {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent-secondary);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vw, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .framework-item.novel {
            border-left-color: var(--accent);
            background: rgba(230, 51, 18, 0.03);
        }

        .framework-item .technique {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.15rem, 0.3vh, 0.3rem);
        }

        .framework-item .addresses {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        /* Bar chart */
        .bar-chart {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-end;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            height: clamp(180px, 40vh, 320px);
            padding-top: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 2rem);
        }

        .bar-item {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .bar {
            width: clamp(50px, 8vw, 90px);
            border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
            position: relative;
            transition: height 1s var(--ease-out-expo);
        }

        .bar-value {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.8rem);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .bar-label {
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            text-align: center;
            max-width: clamp(60px, 10vw, 100px);
            font-weight: 600;
        }

        .bar.vanilla { background: #d1d5db; }
        .bar.deepseek { background: #93c5fd; }
        .bar.dapo { background: #6366f1; }
        .bar.vapo { background: var(--accent); }

        /* Lambda diagram */
        .lambda-diagram {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 3rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .lambda-box {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            text-align: center;
            position: relative;
        }

        .lambda-box h3 {
            font-size: var(--body-size);
            margin-bottom: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vh, 0.5rem);
        }

        .lambda-box .lambda-val {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
            color: var(--accent-secondary);
        }

        .lambda-box .lambda-desc {
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
            margin-top: clamp(0.2rem, 0.4vh, 0.4rem);
        }

        .lambda-box .tradeoff {
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            font-weight: 600;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

        .lambda-box .tradeoff.low-var { color: var(--accent-success); }
        .lambda-box .tradeoff.low-bias { color: var(--accent-secondary); }

        /* Training curve */
        .curve-container {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            position: relative;
            height: clamp(140px, 28vh, 220px);
        }

        .curve-labels {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            margin-top: clamp(0.5rem, 1vh, 1rem);
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .curve-legend {
            display: flex;
            gap: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            margin-top: clamp(0.4rem, 0.8vh, 0.8rem);
        }

        .legend-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
        }

        .legend-dot {
            width: clamp(8px, 1vw, 12px);
            height: 3px;
            border-radius: 1px;
        }

        /* Ablation waterfall */
        .ablation-table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
        }

        .ablation-table th,
        .ablation-table td {
            padding: clamp(0.3rem, 0.6vh, 0.6rem) clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            text-align: left;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .ablation-table th {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--label-size);
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        .ablation-table .score {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 800;
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        .ablation-table .drop {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
            color: var(--accent);
        }

        .ablation-table .critical {
            background: rgba(230, 51, 18, 0.05);
        }

        .drop-bar {
            height: clamp(6px, 0.8vh, 10px);
            background: var(--accent);
            border-radius: 1px;
            opacity: 0.7;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        /* Takeaways */
        .takeaway-list {
            list-style: none;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(0.6rem, 1.2vh, 1.2rem);
        }

        .takeaway-list li {
            padding-left: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 1.5rem);
            border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
            font-size: var(--body-size);
        }

        .takeaway-list li strong {
            display: block;
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--text-primary);
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }

        /* Key stat callout */
        .stat-callout {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: baseline;
            gap: clamp(0.3rem, 0.5vw, 0.5rem);
            margin-top: var(--element-gap);
        }

        .stat-callout .number {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 900;
            font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);
            color: var(--accent);
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .stat-callout .unit {
            font-size: var(--subtitle-size);
            color: var(--text-muted);
        }

        /* Progress bar */
        .progress-bar {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            height: 3px;
            background: var(--accent);
            z-index: 1000;
            transition: width 0.3s ease;
        }

        /* Nav dots */
        .nav-dots {
            position: fixed;
            right: clamp(1rem, 2vw, 2rem);
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: clamp(6px, 1vh, 10px);
            z-index: 100;
        }

        .nav-dot {
            width: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            height: clamp(6px, 0.6vw, 8px);
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--border);
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: background 0.3s, transform 0.3s;
        }

        .nav-dot.active {
            background: var(--accent);
            transform: scale(1.4);
        }

        /* SVG chart styles */
        .chart-svg {
            width: 100%;
            height: clamp(120px, 25vh, 200px);
        }

        .comparison-row {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            margin-top: var(--content-gap);
        }

        .comparison-row .key-point {
            background: var(--bg-primary);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            padding: clamp(0.6rem, 1vw, 1rem);
            flex: 1;
            font-size: var(--small-size);
        }

        .comparison-row .key-point strong {
            font-family: var(--font-display);
            font-weight: 700;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }
    </style>
</head>

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        else this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                }
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <style>

            <div class="accent-bar reveal"></div>
            <h2 class="reveal">Key Takeaways</h2>
            <ul class="takeaway-list reveal" style="margin-top: var(--content-gap);">
                <li>
                    <strong>Value-model-based RL surpasses value-free methods</strong>
                    When the three core challenges (bias, heterogeneous lengths, reward sparsity) are systematically addressed.
                </li>
                <li>
                    <strong>Value-Pretraining is the single most critical component</strong>
                    Contributing 49 points (11 → 60). Without it, value-model-based RL barely functions.
                </li>
                <li>
                    <strong>Length-Adaptive GAE solves heterogeneous sequence lengths</strong>
                    A novel technique dynamically adjusting λ per response — contributing 15 points.
                </li>
                <li>
                    <strong>Superior training stability</strong>
                    VAPO reaches SOTA in ~5,000 steps with zero crashes across multiple independent runs.
                </li>
                <li>
                    <strong>Implications for reasoning model development</strong>
                    Value models are viable for long-CoT RL — the bottleneck was engineering, not the paradigm.
                </li>
            </ul>
        </div>
    </section>

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        else this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                }
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        else this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                }
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

</head>

    <script>
        /* ===========================================
           SLIDE PRESENTATION CONTROLLER
           =========================================== */
        class SlidePresentation {
            constructor() {
                this.slides = document.querySelectorAll('.slide');
                this.currentSlide = 0;
                this.totalSlides = this.slides.length;
                this.setupIntersectionObserver();
                this.setupKeyboardNav();
                this.setupTouchNav();
                this.setupProgressBar();
                this.setupNavDots();
            }

            setupIntersectionObserver() {
                const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                            entry.target.classList.add('visible');
                            const index = Array.from(this.slides).indexOf(entry.target);
                            this.currentSlide = index;
                            this.updateProgressBar();
                            this.updateNavDots();
                        }
                    });
                }, { threshold: 0.5 });

                this.slides.forEach(slide => observer.observe(slide));
            }

            setupKeyboardNav() {
                document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'PageDown') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                    } else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'PageUp') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupTouchNav() {
                let startY = 0;
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { startY = e.touches[0].clientY; });
                document.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => {
                    const diff = startY - e.changedTouches[0].clientY;
                    if (Math.abs(diff) > 50) {
                        if (diff > 0) this.goToSlide(Math.min(this.currentSlide + 1, this.totalSlides - 1));
                        else this.goToSlide(Math.max(this.currentSlide - 1, 0));
                    }
                });
            }

            setupProgressBar() {
                this.progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');
                this.updateProgressBar();
            }

            updateProgressBar() {
                const progress = ((this.currentSlide + 1) / this.totalSlides) * 100;
                this.progressBar.style.width = progress + '%';
            }

            setupNavDots() {
                const container = document.getElementById('navDots');
                for (let i = 0; i < this.totalSlides; i++) {
                    const dot = document.createElement('div');
                    dot.className = 'nav-dot' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
                    dot.addEventListener('click', () => this.goToSlide(i));
                    container.appendChild(dot);
                }
                this.dots = container.querySelectorAll('.nav-dot');
            }

            updateNavDots() {
                this.dots.forEach((dot, i) => {
                    dot.classList.toggle('active', i === this.currentSlide);
                });
            }

            goToSlide(index) {
                this.slides[index].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
            }
        }

        new SlidePresentation();
    </script>

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	"""Convert a single-file HTML presentation into a PPTX deck.
3	
4	Strategy: use Playwright to simulate keyboard navigation (ArrowRight) through
5	the presentation, taking a full-viewport screenshot of each slide, then
6	assemble the images into a 16:9 PPTX via python-pptx.
7	
8	A local HTTP server is started so Google Fonts and relative asset paths load
9	correctly (file:// protocol blocks cross-origin font requests).

11	Usage:
12	    python html_to_pptx.py <input.html> <output.pptx> [--width 1920] [--height 1080]
13	"""

16	import os

18	import subprocess

30	SLIDE_SELECTORS = [".slide", "[data-slide]", "section", "div > section"]
31	
32	
33	def _make_screenshot_script(url: str, out_dir: str, width: int, height: int) -> str:
34	    """Return a Node.js script that navigates and screenshots each slide."""
35	    selectors_js = ", ".join(f'"{s}"' for s in SLIDE_SELECTORS)
36	    return f"""\
37	const {{ chromium }} = require('playwright');
38	
39	(async () => {{
40	    const browser = await chromium.launch({{ executablePath: process.env.PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH || undefined }});
41	    const page = await browser.newPage();
42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});
44	
45	    // --- Count slides using DOM selectors ---
46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];
47	    let slideCount = 0;
48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{
49	        slideCount = await page.$$eval(sel, els => els.length);
50	        if (slideCount > 0) break;
51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---

66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).

68	    let captured = 1;

72	        // Wait for transition animation to complete

74	
75	        const idx = String(i).padStart(3, '0');
76	        const path = `{out_dir}/slide_${{idx}}.png`;
77	        await page.screenshot({{ path }});
78	        captured++;
79	    }}
80	
81	    console.log(JSON.stringify({{ captured }}));
82	    await browser.close();
83	}})();

87	def _deduplicate_slides(image_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
88	    """Remove trailing duplicate screenshots (navigation past last slide).
89	
90	    Some presentations keep showing the last slide when you press ArrowRight
91	    beyond the end.  We detect this by comparing file sizes + pixel samples.
92	    """
93	    pngs = sorted(image_dir.glob("slide_*.png"))
94	    if len(pngs) <= 1:
95	        return pngs
96	
97	    unique: list[Path] = [pngs[0]]
98	    prev_img = Image.open(pngs[0])
99	
100	    for png in pngs[1:]:
101	        curr_img = Image.open(png)
102	        # Quick check: compare a grid of sample pixels
103	        is_dup = True
104	        for x_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
105	            for y_frac in (0.25, 0.5, 0.75):
106	                px = int(curr_img.width * x_frac)
107	                py = int(curr_img.height * y_frac)

109	                    is_dup = False

114	        if not is_dup:

118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique

124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()

135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)
139	    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/{html_path.resolve().name}"
140	
141	    try:

143	        script_file = out_dir / "_capture.cjs"
144	        script_file.write_text(script)
145	
146	        env = os.environ.copy()
147	        env.setdefault("NODE_PATH", "/usr/local/lib/node_modules:/app/node_modules")
148	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH", "/ms-playwright")
149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(
151	            ["node", str(script_file)],
152	            capture_output=True,
153	            text=True,
154	            timeout=180,
155	            env=env,
156	        )
157	        if result.returncode != 0:
158	            print(f"Playwright stderr:\n{result.stderr}", file=sys.stderr)
159	            raise RuntimeError(f"Screenshot script failed (exit {result.returncode})")
160	    finally:
161	        server.shutdown()

163	    pngs = _deduplicate_slides(out_dir)
164	    if not pngs:
165	        raise RuntimeError("No slide screenshots produced")
166	    return pngs

169	def assemble_pptx(slide_images: list[Path], output_path: Path) -> None:
170	    """Pack slide images into a standard 16:9 PPTX."""
171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175	
176	    blank_layout = prs.slide_layouts[6]  # blank layout
177	
178	    for img_path in slide_images:
179	        slide = prs.slides.add_slide(blank_layout)
180	        slide.shapes.add_picture(
181	            str(img_path),
182	            left=Emu(0),
183	            top=Emu(0),
184	            width=prs.slide_width,
185	            height=prs.slide_height,
186	        )
187	
188	    prs.save(str(output_path))

192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198

201

208	        images = screenshot_slides(html_path, tmp_dir, args.width, args.height)

212

42	    await page.setViewportSize({{ width: {width}, height: {height} }});
43	    await page.goto('{url}', {{ waitUntil: 'networkidle' }});

46	    const selectors = [{selectors_js}];

48	    for (const sel of selectors) {{

51	    }}
52	
53	    // Fallback: treat the whole page as 1 slide
54	    if (slideCount === 0) slideCount = 1;
55	
56	    // Reasonable upper bound to prevent infinite loops
57	    if (slideCount > 100) slideCount = 100;
58	
59	    // --- Capture slide 1 (already visible on load) ---
60	    // Wait for entrance animations to settle
61	    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
62	    await page.screenshot({{ path: `{out_dir}/slide_001.png` }});
63	
64	    // --- Navigate through remaining slides via ArrowRight ---
65	    // We track visual changes to detect when navigation has no more effect
66	    // (i.e. we've passed the last slide).
67	    let prevPath = `{out_dir}/slide_001.png`;

79	    }}

112	                break

114	        if not is_dup:
115	            unique.append(png)

117	        else:
118	            # Once we hit a duplicate, stop — remaining are likely all dupes
119	            break
120	
121	    return unique
122	
123	
124	def _start_http_server(directory: Path, port: int = 0):
125	    """Start a background HTTP server serving *directory*. Returns (server, port)."""
126	    handler = http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
127	    server = http.server.HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", port), lambda *a, **kw: handler(*a, directory=str(directory), **kw))
128	    actual_port = server.server_address[1]
129	    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
130	    thread.start()
131	    return server, actual_port
132	
133	
134	def screenshot_slides(html_path: Path, out_dir: Path, width: int, height: int) -> list[Path]:
135	    """Run Playwright to capture per-slide PNGs. Returns deduplicated list."""
136	    # Serve via HTTP so Google Fonts and relative assets load correctly
137	    serve_dir = html_path.resolve().parent
138	    server, port = _start_http_server(serve_dir)

140

146	        env = os.environ.copy()

149	        env.setdefault("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1")
150	        result = subprocess.run(

171	    prs = Presentation()
172	    # Standard 16:9 dimensions
173	    prs.slide_width = Emu(12192000)   # 13.333 inches
174	    prs.slide_height = Emu(6858000)   # 7.5 inches
175

186	        )

192	    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert HTML presentation to PPTX via screenshots")
193	    parser.add_argument("input_html", help="Path to the single-file HTML presentation")
194	    parser.add_argument("output_pptx", help="Output PPTX path")
195	    parser.add_argument("--width", type=int, default=1920, help="Viewport width (default 1920)")
196	    parser.add_argument("--height", type=int, default=1080, help="Viewport height (default 1080)")
197	    args = parser.parse_args()
198	
199	    html_path = Path(args.input_html).resolve()
200	    output_path = Path(args.output_pptx).resolve()
201	
202	    if not html_path.exists():

204

209	        print(f"Captured {len(images)} unique slide(s), assembling PPTX ...")
